task: W02 broadcast, marketing, GitHub, and documentation source follow-up review
scope: Independent visual and source-use review of repaired CAST/MKT masters and exports, 13 GitHub light/dark banner pairs, 13 GitHub social previews, and DOC-01 through DOC-05 source/output diagrams. Covers exact copy, legibility, crop safety, connector/box semantics, palette and identity consistency, opaque output geometry, factual-source alignment, and the boundary between generated artwork/documentation and runtime, deployment, publication, or live evidence. No source, prompt, registry, manifest, ledger, or generated image was edited.

relevant_rules: The Climb — by AI Ascension is the series identity.
Use warm paper, ink, amber, branching paths, and restrained editorial typography.
Use visible evidence labels and do not present generated art as gameplay or product evidence.
Use approved generated identity exports when available; do not silently introduce an unverified logo or monogram.

identity_reference.use: Local generated identity reference named by GH social receipts; no trademark or rights determination.

checks: Compared each selected source with its exact root prompt, receipt, and asset-registry brief where applicable.
Verified all selected source hashes, dimensions, modes, and bytes against local files and pinned generation receipts; all selected sources were RGB and opaque.
Verified all selected output paths, dimensions, modes, bytes, crop boxes, and output digests against the current mechanical export receipt; all selected outputs were RGB and opaque.
Inspected broadcast/marketing/documentation copy, geometry, diagrams, footers, and unwanted marks.
Inspected both themes of all 13 GitHub banner pairs for exact title/role copy, readable horizontal slices, and family consistency.
Inspected all 13 GitHub social sources and full outputs plus central-safe crop contacts; measured luminance>100 bright-content bounds against the prompt safe region.
Cross-checked DOC-03 against the migration plan, DOC-04 against roles.json and CONTRACT.md, and DOC-05 against the offline quickstart and consent playbook.
not_tested: No source, prompt, registry, manifest, ledger, or generated image was edited.
No real-footage host, live status source, game-control path, runtime transition, model decision, settled game action, deployment, publication, or public release was run.
No platform-specific GitHub/social crop behavior was exercised beyond prompt-defined contacts.
No copyright, trademark, license, sponsorship, rights, or legal clearance determination was made.

github_social.basis: Exact prompt requirement central84percent width and central76percent height on 1774x887 source
github_social.measurement: Luminance>100 bright-content bbox; full-source output crop does not exercise platform crop.

crop_reference.note: Source/export crop observations only; no current platform runtime crop or publication authorization.

source_blockers_or_conditions: CAST-03 requires a separate real-footage crop/host check.
GH-04-B/GH-04-S have a family mismatch; GH-04-S also has slight safe-crop overflow.
GH-01-S/GH-05-S/GH-07-S/GH-11-S/GH-13-S have minor safe-crop tolerance/overflow conditions.
GH-02-S/GH-03-S/GH-06-S/GH-08-S/GH-10-S/GH-12-S visibly exceed the prompt safe crop and need creative reflow.
DOC-02 lacks a visible upward arrowhead from Digest-bound approval into Validation.
summary.overall_visual_result: Repaired broadcast/marketing outputs are clean and bounded; GitHub banners are readable with one family condition; social previews preserve exact copy but several fail the prompt safe crop; four of five documentation diagrams are source-ready while DOC-02 has a connector-semantics blocker.
summary.decision: Bounded follow-up source review complete. Ready items may proceed to separate export checks; conditional and blocked items retain their recorded conditions. No broadcast-host, runtime, deployment, publication, legal, trademark, sponsorship, or public-release approval is made.
